# Miraj Events

> Miraj Events, LLC is a wedding planner and day-of wedding coordinator based in Metro Detroit, Michigan, serving Metro Detroit, Toledo and Chicago. Founded and led by Mehreen Buksh. Specialty: multicultural, multi-event wedding weekends (South Asian Muslim, Hindu, Sikh and Jain; Arab and Chaldean; West African and Caribbean; interfaith and fusion), plus engagement parties, nonprofit galas, milestone celebrations and corporate events.

- 50+ multicultural, multi-event weddings in the past two years; largest event 900+ guests.
- Rated 4.9 on Google.
- Service area: Detroit, Sterling Heights, Troy, Rochester Hills, Bloomfield Hills, Novi, Farmington Hills, Dearborn and Ann Arbor (Oakland, Macomb, Wayne and Washtenaw counties), plus Toledo and Chicago.
- Contact: (586) 504-0207 (call, text or WhatsApp) · admin@mirajevent.com · https://www.mirajevent.com/contact
- Replies to inquiries within hours.

## Packages (starting prices, single event)

- [Day-of Coordination](https://www.mirajevent.com/day-of-coordination): from $1,975. Begins 4 weeks out; confirmations, timeline, rehearsal, and running the day from setup to send-off.
- [Design + Coordination](https://www.mirajevent.com/services#design): from $4,750. Adds design: concept, floor plan, décor team and install (décor billed by the vendor).
- [Planning + Design](https://www.mirajevent.com/services#planning): from $6,500. Adds planning from signing: vendors, budget, client portal, hotel block. Most couples choose this.
- [Full Planning](https://www.mirajevent.com/services#full): from $9,500. Full-service planning; the client makes the choices, Miraj carries the rest.
- Multi-event weekends (e.g., Mehndi, Nikkah, Baraat/Shaadi, Valima) are packaged together after a call.
- Add-ons: candy pop-up, photobooth, staging and runways, linens and chairs, backdrops.
- Every package includes a lead planner, a rehearsal walkthrough, one assistant per 100 guests and a preferred vendor list (use of preferred vendors is optional).
